rootGatewayTimeline.sidAssociation: Gateway frame log records class/byteCount/seq only; exact track SID association is missing from gateway telemetry.

rootQueryCostSummary.interpretation: Aggregate query metrics across switching window; queries not span-associated with individual frames. Demonstrates system workload, but no single unique cause inferred.

factualCorrections.beforeSampleVsActualClick: 16:13:35.930Z is the before-sample timestamp in stats(), NOT the click time. Gateway logs confirm the browser sent unsubscribe at 35.652Z and subscribe at 35.653Z (~278ms prior).
factualCorrections.firstPacketTiming: The 16:13:39.545Z post-failure snapshot proves packet arrival occurred BY that sample, not at an exact 486ms post-window mark.
factualCorrections.pgSocketByteCounts: bytesRead: 117 and bytesWritten: 318 are aggregate socket byte counters; they demonstrate socket progression through handshake and SCRAM exchange, but cannot prove exact protocol message receipts or pinpoint backend stall without server event logs.
factualCorrections.webhookLatency: Webhook latency (3.319s) cannot be declared as the causal source of keyframe delay; prior <100ms baseline was not verified across 54/55.
factualCorrections.pgTimeoutTimeline: PG timeout ended at 16:13:25.064Z, ~10.866s prior to window start. No contemporaneous overlap or direct link observed, but timeline separation does not rule out indirect resource contention.
factualCorrections.workingTree: Working tree is dirty with diagnostic and test output artifacts.
